Pakistani court sentences Baloch activist Mehrang Baloch to life imprisonment

A Pakistani court has sentenced Baloch activist Mehrang Baloch to life imprisonment, accusing her of murdering a soldier. The sentencing has drawn criticism and protests, with some framing it as an act of repression against the Baloch people. The event highlights ongoing tensions and human rights concerns in the Balochistan region.
